par-p01.speaker: author (devotional voice)
par-p01.question: Distinct from every lit thing, light itself does not shine as an object — too pervasive to appear; illumined-vs-illuminator is mere convention.
premises: Light itself does not shine as an object — too pervasive to appear.
Illumined-vs-illuminator is mere convention (vyavahāra).
What is, is light, unobjectifiable because everywhere.
uncertainties: Whether 'iyat' (just this much) limits or affirms is unresolved.

par-p02.speaker: author (devotional voice)
par-p02.question: No thing stands dually apart from knowledge; in consciousness there is no difference; the individual, in the one abode of self-luminosity, stays undivided.
premises: No thing stands dually apart from knowledge.
In consciousness there is no difference.
The individual, in the one abode of self-luminosity, stays undivided.

par-p03.speaker: author (devotional voice)
par-p03.question: Dense, one own-consciousness is Śiva himself, the universe's supreme light — yet grasper-grasped division still shines within variegated power.
premises: Dense, one own-consciousness is Śiva himself, the universe's supreme light.
Yet grasper-grasped division still shines within variegated power.
Division shines without dividing the light.
par-p03.inference: Positive declaration after denial; division within the undivided.
uncertainties: Whether 'ittham' (thus) refers back to p01-p02 or opens a new movement is unresolved.

par-p04.speaker: author (devotional voice)
par-p04.question: Difference is not cut off from its ground — free, most-clear, one-abode — then the bare list against the jewel-mirror: palace through mountain, just as from jewel-mirror and the like.
premises: Difference is not cut off from its ground — free, most-clear, one-abode.
Then the bare list: palace, elephant, horse, cloud, ocean, mountain.
Just as of jewel-mirror and the like — reflected things need no ground but the clear mirror.
par-p04.inference: Difference uncut from its ground; the bare list its proof.
uncertainties: Whether the list is exhaustive or exemplary is unresolved.

par-p05.speaker: author (devotional voice)
par-p05.question: If even a common mirror shows prototype-with-reflection as mind-established, the free-consciousness mirror needs no other cause among things.
premises: If a common mirror shows prototype-with-reflection as mind-established...
...then the free-consciousness mirror needs no other cause among things.
Mukhura read as mukura (mirror) — print form kept, reading marked.
par-p05.inference: A fortiori: mind-proven reflection needs no second cause.
uncertainties: Mukhura/mukura reading is an editorial decision, marked here.

par-p06.speaker: author (devotional voice)
par-p06.question: O consciousness-dense one: you indeed are supreme; in you the universes shine at once, flashing by glory-power; you stand as both their maker and their supreme Lord.
premises: O consciousness-dense one: you indeed are supreme.
In you the universes shine at once, flashing by glory-power.
You stand as both their maker and their supreme Lord.
par-p06.inference: Address: all shining, flashing, making is in you.
uncertainties: Whether 'drāk' (at once) modifies shining or flashing is unresolved.

par-p07.speaker: author (devotional voice)
par-p07.question: Established yet unaccomplishable, non-lord yet lord, place-and-time full of own power — eternal, pervasive: Bhairava-Lord, I praise.
premises: Self-consciousness, primordially established, unaccomplishable.
Non-lord and lord at once — three incompatible predicates held.
Whose place and time are full of own power: eternal, pervasive — Bhairava-Lord, I praise.
par-p07.inference: Paradox held without blinking; praise, not proof.
uncertainties: 'vadeśakālam' is obscure; glossed neutrally, marked here.

par-p08.speaker: author (devotional voice)
par-p08.question: The conduct-septad remembered in the heart; the abode entered again; the discussion itself known — the hymn names its own close.
premises: The conduct-septad remembered in the heart by those whose other thoughts are dissolved.
Those enter the supreme abode again, and know the ultimate-thing-discussion.
The hymn names itself at the close.
par-p08.inference: Remembered, entered, known — the hymn closes by naming itself.
uncertainties: Whether 'bhairavīya' is vocative address or genitive is unresolved.

par-p01.plain_english: Distinct from the illumination of sun, moon, lamp and the rest, it does not shine — on account of over-pervasion; and hence: of the nature of light, just this much — illumined-illuminator named is mere convention.
par-p01.sanskrit_cite: arkendudīpādi avabhāsa bhinnam na ābhāti ativyāptatayā ca | tataḥ prakāśarūpam tad iyat prakāśyaprakāśatākhyā vyavahāraḥ eva

par-p02.plain_english: No thing at all is dually distinct from knowledge; made of this and that, in consciousness there is no difference. From self-luminosity, hundredfold, in the one abode — the individual would not indeed be divided.
par-p02.sanskrit_cite: jñānadvibhinnaḥ na hi kaścid arthaḥ tattatkṛtaḥ saṃvidi na asti | bhedaḥ svayamprakāśāt śatam aikadhāmni prātisvikī nāpi vibheditā syāt

par-p03.plain_english: Thus — dense own-consciousness, one indeed: he is Śiva, the universe's supreme light. There too, indeed, shines, in variegated power: apprehended-apprehender-division-difference.
par-p03.sanskrit_cite: ittham svasaṃvidghanaḥ ekaḥ eva śivaḥ saḥ viśvasya paraḥ prakāśaḥ | tatra api bhāti eva vicitraśaktau grāhya gṛhītṛ pravibhāga bhedaḥ

par-p04.plain_english: That difference, and this — not different thence: of the free, most-perfectly-clear one-abode. Palace, elephant, horse, cloud, ocean, mountain and the rest — just as of jewel-mirror and the like.
par-p04.sanskrit_cite: bhedaḥ saḥ ca ayam na tataḥ vibhinnaḥ svacchanda susvacchatama ekadhāmnaḥ | prāsāda hasti aśva payoda sindhu giri ādi yadvat maṇidarpaṇādeḥ

par-p05.plain_english: If, in a mirror's belly, the reflection-making with-prototype would be mind-proven — then in the interior of the mirror of free consciousness, among things there is no other cause besides.
par-p05.sanskrit_cite: ādarśa kukṣau pratibimba kāri sabimbakam syāt yadi mānasiddham svacchanda | saṃvit mukhura antarāle bhāveṣu hetu antaram asti na anyat

par-p06.plain_english: O consciousness-dense one — therefore you indeed are supreme; in you indeed the universes shine at once. And they flash forth by the power of your glory; you indeed are also their supreme-Lord maker.
par-p06.sanskrit_cite: saṃvidghana tena paraḥ tvam eva tvayi eva viśvāni cakāsati drāk sphuranti | ca tvat mahasaḥ prabhāvāt tvam eva ca eṣām parameśa kartā

par-p07.plain_english: Thus — self-consciousness, primordially established, unaccomplishable; the self, non-lord, lord; whose place and time are full of own power — eternal, pervasive: Bhairava-Lord, I praise.
par-p07.sanskrit_cite: ittham svasaṃvedanam ādisiddham asādhyam ātmānam anīśam | īśam svaśaktisaṃpūrṇavadeśakālam nityam vibhum bhairavanātham īḍe

par-p08.plain_english: This septad of good conduct — dissolved other thoughts — those desiring the ultimate rightly remember in the heart. Those, O Bhairava's one, again enter the supreme abode, and know the ultimate-thing-discussion of the three worlds. *Fidelity: preserved (all 8 verses, full pādas from T1). Added: connective phrasing only. Not-resolved: jñānadvibhinna read as dually distinct; śatam kept as printed (hundredfold) against tempting satatam; mukhura read as mukura (mirror); vadeśakālam obscure, glossed neutrally; bhairavīya read as vocative address.*
par-p08.sanskrit_cite: sadvṛtta saptakam idam galitā anya cintāḥ samyak smaranti hṛdaye paramārthakāmāḥ | te bhairavīya paradhāma muhuḥ viśanti jānanti ca trijagatī paramārthacarcām

essence: Distinct from every lit thing, light itself does not shine as an object — too pervasive to appear; illumined-vs-illuminator is mere convention.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is knowledge (jñāna) in the mode of demotion of subject-object; the vyabhicāri is wonder (camatkāra) at light's over-pervasion.

essence: No thing stands dually apart from knowledge; in consciousness there is no difference; the individual, in the one abode of self-luminosity, stays undivided.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is knowledge (jñāna) in the mode of non-duality; the vyabhicāri is wonder at the individual undivided.

essence: Dense, one own-consciousness is Śiva himself, the universe's supreme light — yet grasper-grasped division still shines within variegated power.

rasa.sthayibhava: śānta (tranquility) as dense consciousness is Śiva
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is knowledge (jñāna) in the mode of positive declaration; the vyabhicāri is wonder that division shines without dividing.

essence: Difference is not cut off from its ground — free, most-clear, one-abode — then the bare list against the jewel-mirror: palace through mountain, just as from jewel-mirror and the like.

rasa.sthayibhava: śānta (tranquility) as difference uncut from its ground
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is knowledge (jñāna) in the mode of analogy; the vyabhicāri is clarity (prasāda) of the mirror list.

essence: If even a common mirror shows prototype-with-reflection as mind-established, the free-consciousness mirror needs no other cause among things.

rasa.sthayibhava: śānta (tranquility) as the mirror needing only mind
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is knowledge (jñāna) in the mode of a fortiori; the vyabhicāri is clarity (prasāda) of mind-proven reflection.

essence: O consciousness-dense one: you indeed are supreme; in you the universes shine at once, flashing by glory-power; you stand as both their maker and their supreme Lord.

rasa.sthayibhava: ānanda (bliss) as address to the supreme
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is knowledge (jñāna) in the mode of address (nirṇaya); the vyabhicāri is joy (harṣa) that all shines in you.

essence: Established yet unaccomplishable, non-lord yet lord, place-and-time full of own power — eternal, pervasive: Bhairava-Lord, I praise.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is knowledge (jñāna) in the mode of paradox; the vyabhicāri is wonder (camatkāra) at incompatible predicates held.

essence: The conduct-septad remembered in the heart; the abode entered again; the discussion itself known — it names its own close.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is knowledge (jñāna) in the mode of close (nigamana); the vyabhicāri is peace (śānti) of conduct remembered.

lines: Unlike the light of sun, moon, lamp — it does not shine, pervading too completely. Hence:
of light-nature itself — ‘His illumined-and-illuminator’ is a mere transacting name.
par-p01.sanskrit_cite: arkendudīpādyavabhāsabhinnaṃ nābhātyativyāptatayā tataśca | prakāśarūpaṃ tadiyatprakāśyaprakāśatākhyā vyavahāra eva

lines: Nothing at all stands dually apart from knowledge; made of this and that, in consciousness there is no split.
From self-luminosity, a hundredfold, in the one abode — the individual would never be divided.
par-p02.sanskrit_cite: jñānadvibhinno na hi kaścidarthaḥ tattatkṛtaḥ saṃvidi nāsti bhedaḥ | svayamprakāśācchatam aikadhāmni prātisvikī nāpi vibheditā syāt

lines: Thus — dense self-consciousness, one alone: He is Śiva, the universe’s supreme light.
And there too, in variegated power, shines the split of grasped and grasper.
par-p03.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ svasaṃvidghana eka eva śivaḥ sa viśvasya paraḥ prakāśaḥ | tatrāpi bhātyeva vicitraśaktau grāhyagṛhītṛpravibhāgabhedaḥ

lines: That split — and this one — is not cut off from it: from the free, the flawlessly clear, the single abode.
Palace, elephant, horse, cloud, ocean, mountain, and the rest — just as with jewel, mirror, and the like.
par-p04.sanskrit_cite: bhedaḥ sa cāyaṃ na tato vibhinnaḥ svacchandasusvacchatamaikadhāmnaḥ | prāsādahastyaśvapayodasindhugiryādi yadvanmaṇidarpaṇādeḥ

lines: If, in a mirror’s belly, a reflection — image-making, with its original — were proved by mind alone —
then, within the mirror of free consciousness, things have no other cause at all.
par-p05.sanskrit_cite: ādarśakukṣau pratibimbakāri sabimbakaṃ syād yadi mānasiddham | svacchandasaṃvinmukhuraantarāle bhāveṣu hetvantaram asti nānyat

lines: O dense consciousness — therefore You alone are supreme; in You alone the worlds shine all at once.
And they flash by Your glory’s power — and You alone are their maker, the supreme Lord.
par-p06.sanskrit_cite: saṃvidghanas tena parastvam eva tvayyeva viśvāni cakāsati drāk | sphuranti ca tvanmahasaḥ prabhāvāt tvam eva caiṣāṃ parameśakartā

lines: Thus — self-consciousness, established from the first, never to be effected; the self, no lord and yet lord;
whose place and time are full of its own power — eternal, pervasive: Bhairava, Lord, I praise.
par-p07.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ svasaṃvedanam ādisiddham asādhyam ātmānam anīśam īśam | svaśaktisaṃpūrṇavadeśakālaṃ nityaṃ vibhuṃ bhairavanātham īḍe

lines: This sevenfold good conduct — those whose other thoughts have melted, who long for the ultimate, rightly remember in the heart.
And they — O Bhairava’s own — enter the supreme abode again and again, and know the ultimate discourse of the three worlds.
par-p08.sanskrit_cite: sadvṛttasaptakam idaṃ galitānyacintāḥ samyak smaranti hṛdaye paramārthakāmāḥ | te bhairavīya paradhāma muhur viśanti jānanti ca trijagatīparamārthacarcām

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta as light unobjectifiable; vyabhicāri wonder at over-pervasion (C1 rasa block). Sanskrit-first: arkendudīpādi…bhinnam (distinct FROM lit-things — bhinnam governs the catalogue); na ābhāti ativyāptatayā (does NOT shine, BY-over-pervasion — pervasion is WHY, instrumental named); vyavahāra eva (mere convention — eva restricts). Abhinavagupta frame: subject-object vocabulary demoted exactly where the Sanskrit demotes it (deixis row 11: no pointing added). Rows: 9 (sun/moon/lamp bare catalogue — three lights named, none adorned), 1 (‘name’ end-weighted — the convention-word lands last), 10 (no image imported; the verse has none). Bank: Ingalls-fidelity (no new metaphor; music in the joints: colon + dash). Close: ‘a mere transacting name’. Rupture: ‘Hence:’ (denial turns to naming). Rejected: ‘too pervasive to appear’ — killed: essence-words smuggled into song; ‘lamplight’ — killed: new morpheme; ‘Hence:’ on its own line — killed: colon already stages the turn. Read aloud: un-LIKE the LIGHT of SUN, MOON, LAMP — it does NOT shine … OF-light-NA-ture it-SELF — a MERE trans-ACT-ing NAME.

reads_against.argmap: Distinct from every lit thing, light itself does not shine as an object — too pervasive to appear; illumined-vs-illuminator is mere convention. → Light unobjectifiable; subject-object vocabulary demoted.
c1_essence: Distinct from every lit thing, light itself does not shine as an object — too pervasive to appear; illumined-vs-illuminator is mere convention.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta as non-duality; vyabhicāri wonder at the undivided individual (C1 rasa block). Sanskrit-first: na kiṃcid…dvaitam (NOTHING stands dual — total negation opens); svaprakāśāt…ekadhāmani (from self-luminosity, in the one abode — ground before consequence); na bhajyeta (would NEVER be divided — optative-passive kept as ‘would never’). Rows: 9 (no-split / never-divided echo — the denial returns as protection), 1 (‘divided’ end-weighted — what cannot happen closes the verse), 11 (deixis thinned: ‘this and that’ kept bare, no pointing). Close: ‘would never be divided’. Rupture: the em-dash after ‘that’ (all-things named, then the ground: consciousness). Rejected: ‘in two’ for ‘dually’ — killed: dvaita is the doctrine-word; splitting L1 at the semicolon — killed: semicolon already breathes, a triplet would strand ‘no split’. Read aloud: NO-thing at ALL stands DU-al-ly a-PART … IN-con-SCIOUS-ness there IS no SPLIT … would NE-ver be di-VID-ed.

reads_against.argmap: No thing stands dually apart from knowledge; in consciousness there is no difference; the individual, in the one abode of self-luminosity, stays undivided. → Non-duality: nothing apart from knowledge.
c1_essence: No thing stands dually apart from knowledge; in consciousness there is no difference; the individual, in the one abode of self-luminosity, stays undivided.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta as dense-consciousness-is-Śiva; vyabhicāri wonder that division shines undividing (C1 rasa block). Sanskrit-first: eka eva…sa śivaḥ (one ALONE: HE is Śiva — eva + sa insist); vicitraśaktau…grāhyagrāhakabhedaḥ (in VARIEGATED power — division located inside, not against). Rows: 1 (‘supreme light’ closes L1; ‘grasper’ closes L2 — the split-word last, division landing where it belongs: at the end, inside), 9 (grasped/graspers echo), 12 declined — close is declarative stop, not śānta-fall (the verse declares, then shows). Rupture: ‘And there too’ (identity turns to internal division — the verse's whole move). Rejected: ‘yet’ for ‘And there too’ — killed: tatrāpi is inclusive (there TOO), ‘yet’ would make division an objection; ‘very light’ for ‘supreme light’ — killed: param kept. Read aloud: THUS — DENSE self-CON-scious-ness, ONE a-LONE: HE is ŚI-va … AND-there-TOO … SHINES the SPLIT of GRASPED and GRASP-er.

reads_against.argmap: Dense, one own-consciousness is Śiva himself, the universe's supreme light — yet grasper-grasped division still shines within variegated power. → Positive declaration after denial; division within the undivided.
c1_essence: Dense, one own-consciousness is Śiva himself, the universe's supreme light — yet grasper-grasped division still shines within variegated power.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta as difference uncut; vyabhicāri clarity (prasāda) of the mirror-list (C1 rasa block). Sanskrit-first: na…vicchinna (NOT cut off — the negation governs both splits); svacchāt…ekadhāmnaḥ (from the free, the clear, the one-abode — triple ground-name); maṇidarpaṇādike (jewel-mirror-ETC — ādi closes). Rows: 9 (bare list palace→mountain + jewel/mirror — the list IS the proof, kept bare), 10 (jewel-mirror left standing, no gloss), 1 (‘abode’ gathers L1; L2 closes on ‘and the like’ — ādi enacted: the catalogue refusing to close IS the doctrine). Close: ‘and the like’. Rupture: colon after ‘from it’ (ground stated, then its triple name). Rejected: trimming to three items — killed: six named + ‘rest’ is the pervasion proved; closing on ‘mirror’ — killed: Sanskrit ends ādike, openness load-bearing. Read aloud: THAT-split — AND-this-ONE — is NOT cut-OFF … PA-lace, E-le-phant, HORSE, CLOUD, O-cean, MOUN-tain … JUST-as with JEW-el, MIR-ror, AND-the-LIKE.

reads_against.argmap: Difference is not cut off from its ground — free, most-clear, one-abode — then the bare list against the jewel-mirror: palace through mountain, just as from jewel-mirror and the like. → Difference uncut from its ground; the bare list its proof.
c1_essence: Difference is not cut off from its ground — free, most-clear, one-abode — then the bare list against the jewel-mirror: palace through mountain, just as from jewel-mirror and the like.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta as mirror-needing-only-mind; vyabhicāri clarity of mind-proven reflection (C1 rasa block). Sanskrit-first: yadi…cet…tadā (IF…THEN — protasis long, apodosis certain); manasā eva siddhe (proved BY MIND ALONE — eva restricts the proof); na…anyathā (no OTHER cause — total exclusion closes). Rows: 2 (bimba-pratibimba unpacked: ‘reflection — image-making, with its original’ spilling down the line), 1 (‘at all’ end-weighted — totality), 5 (conditional tread: long supposing line, short necessity line). Rupture: ‘then’ (supposition turns to necessity). Rejected: ‘picture’ for reflection — killed: pratibimba is technical (counter-image); ‘for free’ wordplay on free consciousness — killed: pun smuggling doctrine (svatantra ≠ gratis). Read aloud: IF, in a MIR-ror's BEL-ly … WERE-proved BY-mind a-LONE — THEN, with-IN the MIR-ror OF-free CON-scious-ness … NO-o-ther-CAUSE at-ALL.

reads_against.argmap: If even a common mirror shows prototype-with-reflection as mind-established, the free-consciousness mirror needs no other cause among things. → A fortiori: mind-proven reflection needs no second cause.
c1_essence: If even a common mirror shows prototype-with-reflection as mind-established, the free-consciousness mirror needs no other cause among things.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: ānanda as address; vyabhicāri joy (harṣa) that all shines in You (C1 rasa block). Sanskrit-first: tvam eva…tvaṃ eva (YOU alone…You ALONE — eva hammered thrice, kept thrice); mahimnaḥ śaktyā (BY GLORY'S POWER — genitive force, kept); kartā…parameśvaraḥ (maker…supreme Lord — both offices named). Rows: 7 (vocative ‘O dense consciousness’ opens — direct current, anti-vighna), 9 (You-alone ×3 anaphora), 1 (‘supreme Lord’ closes — maker + Lord gathered). Close: ‘the supreme Lord’. Rupture: ‘And they flash’ (shining turns to flashing/making — stasis to power). Rejected: ‘You only’ — killed: eva is alone (exclusion), ‘only’ weakens to mere-ness; ‘by Your glorious power’ — killed: flattens the genitive (glory's-POWER acts). Read aloud: O-DENSE con-SCIOUS-ness — THERE-fore YOU a-LONE are su-PREME … AND-they-FLASH … YOU a-LONE are their MA-ker, the su-PREME-lord.

reads_against.argmap: O consciousness-dense one: you indeed are supreme; in you the universes shine at once, flashing by glory-power; you stand as both their maker and their supreme Lord. → Address: all shining, flashing, making is in you.
c1_essence: O consciousness-dense one: you indeed are supreme; in you the universes shine at once, flashing by glory-power; you stand as both their maker and their supreme Lord.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta as paradox held; vyabhicāri wonder at incompatibles held (C1 rasa block). Sanskrit-first: siddhaṃ akāryam (ESTABLISHED yet uneffectable — siddha kept against akārya, no smoothing); anīśa īśa (NO-LORD yet LORD — kept paired); stauti (I PRAISE — the verb IS the verse's end). Rows: 9 (paradox pairs kept paired, never resolved — established/uneffected, no-lord/yet-lord), 7 (‘Bhairava, Lord’ vocative before the praise-verb — address then act), 1 (‘I praise’ closes — after all doctrine, the act). Close: ‘I praise’. Rupture: semicolon before ‘the self, no lord’ (metaphysics turns to self-naming). Rejected: ‘lord beyond lordship’ — killed: smoothing kills the paradox (Bar 6: never smooth); ‘I sing’ — killed: stauti is praise-speech, song would name the medium. Read aloud: THUS — SELF-con-SCIOUS-ness … NEV-er to be ef-FECT-ed; NO-lord AND-yet-LORD … BHAI-ra-va, LORD, i-PRAISE.

reads_against.argmap: Established yet unaccomplishable, non-lord yet lord, place-and-time full of own power — eternal, pervasive: Bhairava-Lord, I praise. → Paradox held without blinking; praise, not proof.
c1_essence: Established yet unaccomplishable, non-lord yet lord, place-and-time full of own power — eternal, pervasive: Bhairava-Lord, I praise.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta as remembered-entered-known; vyabhicāri peace of conduct remembered (C1 rasa block). Sanskrit-first: smaranti…viśanti…viduḥ (REMEMBER…ENTER…KNOW — the ascent order kept); punaḥ punar (AGAIN and AGAIN — doubled, kept doubled); nigamana (the hymn names its own close — seal-effect). Rows: 9 (‘again and again’ anchor), 6 (self-naming close kept as anchor — ‘ultimate discourse’ verbatim, never reworded), 12 (śānta-fall: ‘three worlds’ — wide, still, long vowels close the whole work). Close: ‘the three worlds’. Rupture: ‘And they’ (conduct turns to persons — the remembered becomes the rememberers). Rejected: ‘often’ — killed: repetition IS the practice; reordering to close on ‘known’ — killed: remembered→entered→known is the ascent. Read aloud: THIS-SEVEN-fold GOOD-con-DUCT … RIGHT-ly re-MEM-ber … EN-ter the su-PREME a-BODE a-GAIN and a-GAIN … DIS-course OF the THREE-worlds.

reads_against.argmap: The conduct-septad remembered in the heart; the abode entered again; the discussion itself known — the hymn names its own close. → Remembered, entered, known — the hymn closes by naming itself.
c1_essence: The conduct-septad remembered in the heart; the abode entered again; the discussion itself known — it names its own close.
